_what: THE WORLD OF BLUEFIN -- the chapter that replaces act II's front in the YouTube release: 2001: A Space Odyssey's Dawn of Man sequence (Warner Classics upload 5NShEY1ScSY) cut down to its story beats, then the Nightwish Darwin clip (renders/efmb-front.mkv 4.0 -> 70.4667, clean), hard cut, each part keeping its own audio. The cut list is EDIT_2001 in scripts/build_world_of_bluefin.py: source 86.0 -> 504.295 compressed from 6:43 to 2:05 (silent vistas and repeated foraging dropped, one shot or sound event kept per beat), then 504.295 -> 679.2333 untouched (owner: '7m-11m is finished'). The rest of Endless Forms Most Beautiful becomes a standalone.
_version: 2 -- 2026-09-25: first segment compressed to the story beats (owner: 'compress the first segment ... cut out the monotonous ones for modern audiences, ensure we are capturing 2001 story beats as outlined by the book'); title swap as v1

panels: A once promising line of Linux
Millions of years of predation and infighting
Until cloud native came to their world
New rules in play, new species evolved
To unmake those that had come before
plates.note: Owner, 2026-09-25: 'ONe intro slide, fade these lines in before the rest of the video, make it awesome like a cinematic movie', six lines with a blank line after the third -- that break is the card split; then 'stick the 2nd slide at the dark transition 02:25' and 'I want 2 split cards': panel 0 opens the film, panel 1 sits in the black before the monolith. The owner then edited both panels here directly. Set in Jost Light, tracked capitals; timing in scripts/build_world_of_bluefin.py (PROLOGUE_*, CARD_BEFORE).

Owner, 2026-09-25, verbatim: 'reaplce "the dawn of man" slide in the movie with "A World before Kubernetes" so that it looks like the movie came that way, make it subtle and perfect', 'rescue the image though, overlay with a black box but be exact', 'render the world before kubernetes longer than the original so you hide it entirely if needbe', and 'ship whatever looks best'. The source card's ink is 1080p x=516..1396, y=670..736, colour ~rgb(155,175,178), up 92.4 -> 93.8 and down 97.6 -> 100.2; the shot cuts at 100.768. Box and words are fully up 91.0 -> 92.4, before the old words show; the box covers exactly the old ink, filled with the shot's own sky tone (the black box read as a sticker on review), and leaves with the cut; the words fade over the shot's last 2 s. Typeface: Marcellus, fitted to the card's measured ink box.
